import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix label variants in 'island' (normalize to title case)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.capitalize()
    
    # Fix label variants in 'sex' (strip whitespace)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip() if df['sex'].dtype == 'object' else df['sex']
    
    # Convert text numbers to numeric for specified columns
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
